slot_order_rule: one transition per distinct mapped outcome (rmg_moves.product_key): every directed mapping reaching one mapped product -- both template slot orders of a pair when the template is symmetric (identical or unequal radicals recombining: one product per site pair), every reactant resonance form, every subgraph isomorphism -- is one transition; an ordered template (disproportionation: acceptor/donor) keeps the two slot orders apart because they give different mapped products; an A + A pair is two separate copies
